metaTitle: Custom Round Door Hangers | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom round door hangers in bulk from Perfect Imprints. Choose from paper or Superseal materials for your next campaign.
introHtml: Round door hangers stand out from standard rectangular shapes, drawing attention with their unique silhouette. Whether you're promoting a grand opening, announcing a service area, or delivering safety reminders, the circular format gives your message a distinctive look that catches the eye. Our round door hangers are available in durable paper with UV coating or heavy-duty Superseal for outdoor use. Both options accept full-color printing on one or both sides, making them ideal for marketing directors and safety managers who need high-impact, weather-resistant materials for bulk distribution.
heroAltText: A stack of custom round door hangers printed with full-color graphics and a hole for hanging on doorknobs
